title: Spicy Shrimp Spring Rolls
description: A twist on traditional Mexican spring rolls, these are filled with juicy shrimp and crunchy vegetables, then fried to a golden brown.
instructions: Heat 1/4 cup of the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cabbage to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the shrimp to the skillet and cook until pink and fully cooked, about 2-3 minutes per side.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked shrimp and vegetables, cilantro, salt, and black pepper.
Add the spring rolls to the bowl and toss to combine.
Heat the remaining 1/4 cup of vegetable oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add a few of the spring rolls to the pan and fry until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Repeat with the remaining spring rolls.
Drain the fried spring rolls on paper towels and serve hot.
Garnish with chipotle peppers and serve with your favorite dipping sauce.
